title: Power Platform Executive - Workflow Automation
company: Agensi Pekerjaan Times Management Consultancy Sdn. Bhd.
job_description:
Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or related discipline. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Automate and Microsoft Power Platform environments. Familiarity with Power Apps, Power BI, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Experience in workflow troubleshooting, automation support, and business process improvement. Basic understanding of APIs, JSON, connectors, triggers, approvals, and workflow logic is an advantage. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Able to work independently while managing multiple support and enhancement requests. Prior experience in application support, workflow automation, or customer-facing support environment is an added advantage.Job location - Petaling Jaya

Support, maintain, and troubleshoot existing Microsoft Power Platform solutions, primarily Power Automate workflows and related applications. Analyze business processes and identify automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual work. Design, develop, test, and deploy workflow automation solutions using Microsoft Power Automate. Support integration between Power Platform solutions and Microsoft 365 applications such as SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Excel, and other business systems. Investigate workflow issues, failed executions, and system errors through logs, flow monitoring, and data validation. Gather business requirements and translate them into practical automation and workflow solutions. Perform workflow enhancements, change requests, optimization, and continuous improvement activities. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, workflow specifications, and user support materials. Provide user support, troubleshooting assistance, and guidance related to workflow and automation processes. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, business users, and technical teams to ensure smooth implementation and support of automation initiatives.

Annual Leave Medical and Hospitalisation Leave EPF SOCSO EIS Training Provided 5 Working Days
